mediation_trap_resolved.problem: Original mediation showed only 1.3% of effect via competition
mediation_trap_resolved.root_cause: Mediation measured INTENSIVE margin (bidder count), not EXTENSIVE margin (single vs multi)
mediation_trap_resolved.solution: Competition operates primarily at EXTENSIVE margin - moving contracts from single to multi-bidder
mediation_trap_resolved.reframe: The 'direct effect' in original mediation IS ALSO competition operating at extensive margin

title_defense.mechanism: Competition enables supplier selection among alternatives with different efficiency levels
title_defense.counterfactual: If all contracts competitive, carbon would be 1.6% lower

large_contract_explanation.explanation: Sector composition drives reversal; within sectors, competition still benefits
